title: SolveMate
description: AI-powered full-stack study companion with a React/Vite frontend, Spring Boot REST API, and a Flask ML service backed by Google Gemini. Deployed on Railway with a MySQL database and a custom domain.

title: Craftfolio
description: Personal portfolio site built from scratch with responsive design, smooth animations, and clean component architecture. Deployed on Vercel.

title: ScamShield
description: Binary classification system that ingests structured input data and predicts risk levels using a trained ML pipeline, with threshold tuning to balance precision and recall.

title: FMSC GPA Calculator
description: A GPA calculator built specifically for FMSC students, supporting the faculty's grading scheme. Calculate semester and cumulative GPA instantly with a clean, easy-to-use interface.

title: GoAnime
description: Anime discovery web app powered by the AniList GraphQL API. Search by title, filter by genre and format, and explore detailed info including synopsis, ratings, episode count, and trailer links.

title: CinePulse
description: Real-time facial emotion detection pipeline that maps a user's detected mood to a curated movie recommendation, combining computer vision with a content-based filtering engine.

title: BookInn
description: Full-stack hotel booking platform with an admin dashboard for managing rooms, guest reservations, and booking status. Deployed live on Vercel.

title: Customer Churn Predictor
description: End-to-end churn prediction model built on telecom data. Engineered features, compared classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost), and surfaced key churn drivers via SHAP explainability.

title: Debit Card Online Issuer
description: Group university project — a web-based debit card issuance platform built with a custom PHP MVC architecture. Handles card application workflows, user management, and database-driven record tracking.

title: Hanako-san
description: An emotion-aware support companion that parses user queries using intent classification and entity extraction, responding with empathy-driven replies tuned to the user's detected mood.

title: Brainiac Attack
description: 2D action game built in Python featuring DC Universe characters. Players battle through levels with custom sprite animations, sound effects, and collision logic built with Pygame.

title: Robot Wars
description: 2D robot combat game built with Python and Pygame, featuring sprite-based characters, sound effects, and image assets. Players battle it out in an arena-style environment with custom game logic.

title: Space Wars
description: A browser-based space shooter game where players pilot a spacecraft, dodge incoming fire, and battle enemy ships across progressively harder waves.
